title: WATCH: The Axios Media Trends Live summit
source: Axios — WATCH: The Axios Media Trends Live summit (2026-10-20)
body: Tune in at 2:55 p.m. ET for an afternoon of programming focused on the future of publishing, entertainment, sports, advertising and technology, hosted by Axios media correspondent Sara Fischer and media reporter Kerry Flynn. We'll break down the trends transforming the media business with the decision-makers, disruptors and the newsmakers of today., Featured guests: Hearst president and CEO Steven Swartz United Wholesale Mortgage president and CEO and Phoenix Suns and Mercury owner Mat Ishbia Anonymous Content president and CEO Darren Walker Actor and comedian Kenan Thompson and Range Media Partners CEO and co-founder Peter Micelli iHeartMedia chairman and CEO Bob Pittman FCC Commissioner Anna Gomez Versant CEO Mark Lazarus Writer and producer Lena Waithe Dow Jones CEO and Wall Street Journal publisher Almar Latour and Wall Street Journal editor-in-chief Emma Tucker Trump Media & Technology Group CEO Kevin McGurn
